findings.desc: AGENTS.md / B-d854 checklist evidence — acceptance-blocking missing proof: CHK-001:happy:0 and CHK-003:happy:0 claim a 26-row RED-to-GREEN audit, but rg -n "26-row|AGENTS_RED_GREEN|RED_GREEN" .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-d854 AGENTS.md finds only summary prose in checklist.json; there is no row-by-row ledger, command, captured RED output, captured GREEN output, or signed receipt mapping each of the 26 asserted corrections to an authoritative source. The existing mechanical checks cover Unicode, a small token inventory, and 20 command names, not the claimed 26 behavioral rows. Because the user explicitly requested evidence that the previously identified issues were RED then GREEN, this unsupported aggregate claim blocks acceptance. Add a reproducible 26-row artifact/evidence record and bind its exact command/output to current AGENTS.md before re-review. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: The committed 26-row audit ledger in docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md and commit 46197017 provide durable RED commands, authority references, and GREEN receipts; node tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs --final exits 0.

findings.desc: AGENTS.md:55-58 conflicts with the current canonical reviewer contract. The guide says Never directly read or write Story or fixture JSON, while review_run_start for this same Story requires the reviewer to read .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-d854/background.md, plan.md, and checklist.json. The managed thin block at AGENTS.md:9 correctly prohibits direct edits only, and direct reads do not bypass signatures, hashes, locks, receipts, or lifecycle mutation validation. This overbroad prohibition makes a reviewer violate AGENTS.md in order to satisfy the canonical role prompt and therefore fails the requested prompt-consistency audit. Narrow the rule to direct writes/mutations, and state that bounded read-only reviewer inputs named by a canonical prompt are permitted; retain CLI reads for ordinary state inspection. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: AGENTS.md now prohibits direct Story JSON writes and unbounded inspection while explicitly permitting bounded read-only canonical-prompt reviewer inputs; ordinary inspection remains CLI-first. Verified by the final audit ledger and verifier.

findings.desc: AGENTS.md:18-23 / Story verification evidence — acceptance requires a claim-by-claim audit ledger and the user specifically asked whether every previously identified issue has RED then GREEN proof. The only persisted docs_check note says “the 26-row RED/GREEN matrix passed” and lists a few broad source ranges, but no 26 rows, per-row baseline failure, final pass condition, authoritative citation, command, exit code, or captured output are present. A reviewer cannot reproduce or inspect the claimed matrix, so the proof request is not delivered even though the final wording appears to address the 24 major and 2 low-priority groups. Fix by recording and presenting the actual 26-row RED→GREEN ledger, with each row independently tied to the baseline line, final line, authority and runnable evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of B-d854:F-001: the same missing durable per-issue RED/GREEN ledger was resolved by the committed 26-row audit report and final verifier receipt.

findings.desc: AGENTS.md:16-566 — “translate the complete root AGENTS.md” was implemented as an undocumented consolidation, not a fully accounted translation. The baseline has 598 lines/32 fences/41 table rows/11 blockquotes; the final has 566/20/21/0. A deterministic command inventory finds 14 still-current repository-local CLI examples removed from runnable guidance (aux_detail, aux_diagnose, aux_scan, aux_sync, aux_trace, decision_get, decision_set, fixture_batch_add, gap_log, story_create, test_fixture, test_story, understanding_get, understanding_set; each --help exits 0). The evidence supplies only the blanket sentence “obsolete and duplicate legacy sections consolidated” rather than listing each intentional removal and justification, contrary to CHK-002:edge:0 and the complete-translation request. Restore faithful English coverage or provide a complete itemized audit proving every deletion is an authorized consistency correction rather than lost content.
findings.resolvedReason: AGENTS.md restores the 14 current CLI examples removed by the earlier consolidation, while the audit ledger accounts for intentional current/legacy changes. Structural inventories and mutation rejection pass in node tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs --final.

findings.desc: AGENTS.md:492-530 / CHK-001:adversarial:0 and CHK-003:adversarial:0 evidence — the active-command checker is a false-green oracle for exact examples. Its regex retains only a command name (plus the codex subcommand), then invokes `<command> --help`; it discards every documented argument and never runs concrete read-only examples or validates mutating payloads in a disposable repository/schema path. Therefore an example with a nonexistent flag, wrong payload field, or invalid value would still pass. This fails the pinned intent that every active example be operational and that read-only/mutating examples be exercised safely. Replace it with an extractor that validates each complete example and include a deliberately malformed-argument mutation in addition to the nonexistent-command sentinel.
findings.resolvedReason: The verifier executes the exact 42-case command-contract ledger, validates full argv/schema for mutating examples, executes safe read-only examples, and rejects unknown and malformed invocations; final receipt exits 0.

findings.desc: AGENTS.md:220-225,307-313,439-440,494-529 — acceptance-blocking false-green in the active-command verification: these blocks contain concrete phase-changing, mutating, and read-only examples, but the recorded CHK-001:adversarial:0 / CHK-003:adversarial:0 checker extracts only the first command token (special-casing codex) and runs `<command> --help`. It never validates the displayed argv or placeholder structure, never executes read-only examples with repository-valid arguments, and never schema-validates mutating examples in an isolated repository, despite both must-intents requiring exactly those checks. A command can therefore have valid help while every documented invocation is malformed and the receipt still reports PASS. Replace the prefix-only smoke with a case ledger that binds each active example to its exact argv and either executes it read-only, validates it through the registered schema in isolation, or explicitly classifies it as conceptual; keep the invalid sentinel. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of B-d854:F-005: the command verifier now validates exact arguments and schema and earns a 42/42 execution receipt instead of checking only command names or help.

findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:0 and CHK-003:happy:0 lack concrete verificationEvidence for the claimed 26-row RED-to-GREEN audit. The only persisted evidence is a docs_check note that says the matrix passed and names broad sources; git grep finds no row-by-row ledger, per-row baseline failure, final pass condition, authoritative line, command, exit code, or captured output. A fresh reviewer cannot rerun or inspect the aggregate claim, so both must intents remain uncovered. Add a durable 26-row ledger and bind rerunnable receipts to the current AGENTS.md. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of B-d854:F-001: the durable report now preserves the independent Claude and Agy evidence plus exact RED/GREEN rows, rather than leaving the proof only in transient review output.

findings.desc: CHK-001:adversarial:0 and CHK-003:adversarial:0 are not covered by the recorded command checker. Its implementation extracts only command names and appends --help; it never executes read-only examples with their documented arguments and never validates mutating example payloads in an isolated repository or against the registered schema. Independent mutation proof appended `proof-or-stop story_get --storyId`: the real invocation exits 1 for invalid boolean storyId, while the checker input set is unchanged and would remain green. The invalid-command sentinel tests name rejection only, not example validity. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of B-d854:F-005: safe active examples are executed with repository-valid arguments and malformed story_get arguments are rejected; mutating examples use registered schema without changing the Story.

findings.desc: CHK-002:edge:0 lacks the deterministic structural and technical-token inventory it requires. The evidence checks marker/fence balance, aggregate heading/table counts, and only 18 selected tokens; it does not compare list nesting, blockquotes, fence language tags, links, all paths, command/role identifiers, JSON keys, phase/story identifiers, or enumerate every intentional difference. Independent mutation proof changed `scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs` to `scripts/WRONG.mjs`, and the recorded checker still accepts the document. This must intent remains uncovered. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: The structural checker inventories headings, nesting, tables, blockquotes, fences, HTML markers, links, paths, commands, roles, JSON keys, phases and Story tokens; a WRONG-path mutation is rejected.

findings.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:0 lacks valid comprehensive semantic-drift evidence. Its manual_transcript has no result or tool receipt, and its detector checks only three literal phrases. Independent mutation proof changed the lifecycle rule from `Document implementation changes are allowed only here` to `allowed in every phase`; the detector still accepts it. The intent requires review of every normative/lifecycle-sensitive sentence and representative polarity/modality/current-versus-legacy mutations, so a three-string detector plus an unsupported review note is insufficient. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: The verifier binds 97 normative sentences and rejects four semantic mutations covering remote-push polarity, advisory-to-mandatory, current/legacy erasure and DEV-only scope expansion; the final receipt exits 0.

findings.desc: CHK-003:edge:1 is only partially covered. The evidence records the local invocation string and version plus the global invoked path, version, and canonical realpath, but it computes `fs.realpathSync` only for `/opt/homebrew/bin/proof-or-stop`; it never records the canonical resolved realpath for the repository-local `node bin/proof-or-stop.js` authority even though the intent explicitly requires invoked path and canonical realpath for each runtime. Add the local canonical path/realpath to a fresh mechanical receipt. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: The final verifier records local and global invoked paths, canonical realpaths and versions, and reports VERSION_AND_REALPATH_DRIFT explicitly, keeping the repository-local worktree CLI authoritative.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:18-21 / tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:111-116 — WHY high acceptance blocker: the claimed row-by-row RED proof can report RED even when the row-specific stale condition was never detected, because baseline mode uses `redPattern.test(baselineText) || !greenPattern.test(baselineText)`. Independent evaluation shows A06 redPattern=false and A17 redPattern=false while `node tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs --baseline` still prints both as RED. Therefore 26/26 RED does not prove each recorded original defect; make baseline rows require the exact row-specific RED predicate (and keep a separate expected absence assertion if useful), then preserve a failing baseline receipt for every row.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit e5a6bbfa replaces the baseline `redPattern || !greenPattern` oracle with one-to-one M01-M24/L01-L02 rows whose full row-specific predicate set must pass. Owner rerun shows every predicate true and baseline exit 1.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:29-53 — WHY high acceptance blocker: the 26-row ledger is not a one-to-one proof of the previously enumerated 24 major plus 2 low-priority defects. In particular baseline AGENTS.md:238 supplied Chinese checklist payload text, while packages/main/src/handlers/story-create.ts:742-750 rejects CJK authoring fields before persistence; no audit row records that RED condition or its GREEN correction. Conversely A17-A20 split one orchestration cluster, and A26 bundles test_auto confirmation with old subagent-prompt guidance while its mechanical GREEN predicate in tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs checks only the explicit-confirm sentence. Thus row count 26 does not establish coverage of the exact reported 26-item set. Add a stable provenance mapping for every originally reported item, including a dedicated CJK-payload row and independently checked predicates for both low-priority items.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit e5a6bbfa maps exactly M01-M24 plus L01-L02 in order: A06 is dedicated CJK story_create rejection, A25 is bare test_auto/--confirm, and A26 is legacy reviewer/prompt guidance. Audit document and verifier enforce the mapping.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:1-128 — WHY high acceptance blocker: the user explicitly required Claude CLI and Agy CLI to participate in the independent consistency evaluation, but the durable audit contains no Claude/Agy session identity, transcript hash, command, verdict, or provenance at all (repository search for Claude, Agy, AGY, claude-cli, and the known session identifiers finds no independent-review record in this artifact). Host-only narrative at final handoff would not let a fresh reviewer reproduce or authenticate that requested participation. Add a bounded external-review evidence section binding provider/CLI version, session or transcript identity, SHA-256, exact audit prompt/scope, salient independently confirmed or rejected findings, and explain that repository-local implementation remains the behavior authority.
findings.resolvedReason: The audit now records Claude Code 2.1.258 and Agy CLI 1.1.23 versions, full session/conversation IDs, transcript/captured-output paths, SHA-256 hashes, scope, raw verdicts and owner reconciliation. Owner final run verifies both local artifacts.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:17-21 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:74-97 — doc-proof-false-red: WHY high acceptance blocker: independent replay proves baseline A06 and A17 print RED and exit 1 even though their row-specific redPattern values are both false. runAuditRows uses redPattern OR absence-of-green, so absence of final wording can manufacture RED without detecting the recorded original defect. The durable 26/26 RED claim is therefore not row-specific proof. Require each row's exact baseline defect predicate to match, or explicitly model an expected-absence predicate as a separate tested condition, before calling that row RED.
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of B-d854:F-012; the row-specific false-RED oracle was independently reported and is fixed by the same e5a6bbfa predicate-set implementation and baseline receipt.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:25-52 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:30-57 — doc-provenance-mapping-gap: WHY high acceptance blocker: the ledger count is not a one-to-one mapping of the requested original 24 major plus 2 low-priority issues. Baseline AGENTS.md:238 contains Chinese authoring payload values, while packages/main/src/handlers/story-create.ts:744-750 rejects CJK authoring before persistence, yet no audit row or verifier predicate records that distinct RED/GREEN correction. Meanwhile A17-A20 split one orchestration cluster, and A26 combines both low-priority issues but mechanically checks only test_auto confirmation. Add stable original-item IDs, a dedicated CJK-payload row, and independently enforced predicates for each low-priority item; do not infer exact coverage from row count.
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of B-d854:F-013; exact original 24+2 mapping, dedicated CJK row, and separate low-priority rows are enforced in e5a6bbfa.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:1-128 — doc-external-review-provenance-missing: WHY high acceptance blocker: the user-required Claude CLI and Agy CLI participation is not durably evidenced. Independent case-insensitive search of the audit for Claude, Agy, session, transcript, and independent-review provenance finds no provider/CLI version, session or transcript identity, SHA-256, exact audit scope/prompt, or per-finding verdict. Mentions of Claude in AGENTS.md describe adapter assets, not this audit participation. Add bounded external-review provenance and state that repository-local implementation remains the behavior authority.
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of B-d854:F-014; durable Claude/Agy provenance and artifact hash verification were added in e5a6bbfa.

findings.desc: tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:162 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:196-199 classify aux_diagnose/test_fixture as conceptual without proving the command resolves or --help succeeds. Repro in a detached temp worktree: patch bin/proof-or-stop.js so aux_diagnose --help exits 1 (observed Unknown command: aux_diagnose), then run node tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs --final; it still exits 0 and prints CASE 29 PASS. This violates CHK-001:adversarial:0 and CHK-003:adversarial:0, which require every active command example to resolve and the checker to reject invalid commands.
findings.resolvedReason: Every active/conceptual command now resolves real `--help` before schema or execution. Owner run reports COMMAND_AVAILABILITY_MUTATION aux_diagnose REJECTED and test_fixture REJECTED while all 42 valid cases pass.

findings.desc: tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:301-336 limits semantic coverage to sentences containing a small keyword regex and four hand-picked phrases. Repro: in a detached temp worktree invert AGENTS.md INIT guidance from The CLI does not automatically invent missing reviewer evidence to The CLI automatically invents missing reviewer evidence, update only the audit Final SHA-256 to the mutated file, and run node tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs --final; it exits 0 with all four SEMANTIC_MUTATION lines and AGENTS_VERIFY FINAL GREEN. This is a lifecycle/authority inversion that CHK-002:adversarial:0 explicitly requires the verifier to reject.
findings.resolvedReason: The semantic policy now binds the no-auto-invention reviewer-evidence rule and rejects SEMANTIC_MUTATION review-evidence-auto-invention even when other document hashes remain current; owner final run exits 0.

findings.desc: tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:248-299,338-345 and 384-399 do not mechanically prove complete English content or preservation of ordinary prose once the mutable audit SHA is refreshed. Two detached-temp-worktree repros each updated only the audit Final SHA-256 and still made node tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs --final exit 0: (1) replace Keep data, logic, and rendering separated with ASCII Spanish Mantenga los datos, la logica y la representacion separados; Unicode reports nonAscii=0, and (2) delete the baseline-derived sentence Classify a new function before placing it; the structural inventory digest stays unchanged. These false greens violate CHK-002:happy:0 and CHK-002:edge:0 plus the report claim that no deletion is unrecorded.
findings.resolvedReason: The verifier now binds the complete prose inventory and immutable reviewed AGENTS SHA, and rejects ASCII Spanish substitution plus ordinary-prose deletion even with simulated refreshed audit SHA; Unicode checks remain zero.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:87,92-93,96,99 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:457-483 — WHY high acceptance blocker: CHK-001:happy:0 requires every claim-by-claim ledger row to name an authoritative implementation/registry/prompt/decision source with a line reference. Rows A14, A20, and A23 provide only `machine.ts`/`done-prepare.ts` prose with no line reference; A19 and A26 append vague `reviewer/quorum handlers` or `current registry` without identifying the source locations for the claimed behavior. The final verifier nevertheless prints GREEN because auditDocumentChecks only verifies the Axx-to-Mxx/Lxx prefixes, hashes, counts, and provenance tokens; it never validates a per-row authority path and line reference. Thus the durable evidence is not independently traceable and the green receipt overstates the must-intent. Fix each affected row with exact authoritative file:line citations for all material behavior claimed, and make the verifier reject missing or non-line-addressed row sources.
findings.resolvedReason: All 26 audit rows now carry exact authoritative path:line citations; the verifier binds each row sourcePath/sourcePattern to its current line and rejects citation removal or vague replacement even with refreshed document hashes.

findings.desc: AGENTS.md:297-303 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:53 — WHY high acceptance blocker: M14 is still only partially GREEN. The original defect explicitly included unresolved scope-check openQuestions and the ProofStory/scope-contract prerequisites, but the final PLAN guidance names signed scope-check evidence and generic scope/memory readiness without telling the operator that every scope-check open question must be resolved through scope_question_resolve before story_review can pass, and it does not identify the scope-contract prerequisite. Current packages/main/src/handlers/story-review.ts:661-682 creates a blocking scope_open_question_unresolved issue, while the A14 GREEN predicate checks only the phrase signed scope-check.json evidence and a lifecycle-registry scope-check token. Therefore A14 can report GREEN without the omitted current gate semantics being delivered. Add the missing open-question resolution and scope-contract guidance and make A14 mechanically require those distinct corrections.
findings.resolvedReason: AGENTS now states the signed scope-check, supported scope_question_resolve flow for unresolved openQuestions, scope_contract_init_from_plan/set/check prerequisites, and the advisory-versus-hard gate boundary. M14 omission and inversion mutations are rejected.

findings.desc: AGENTS.md:340-374, docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:92, and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:58 — WHY high acceptance blocker: M19 still omits the current reviewer roster/lane opt-in surface from the final guide. The repository registers reviewer_list as the read-only opt-in roster command (command-catalog.ts:2508-2510; reviewer-list.ts:2-18), but AGENTS.md never names reviewer_list or explains that active lanes are policy-computed. The audit row nevertheless claims roster/batch and lane opt-in are corrected, while its GREEN predicate checks only the dispatch sentence and agent-dispatch-registry canonicalName; it would remain GREEN if agent_prompt, reviewer_batch, quorum and roster guidance disappeared. Add reviewer_list/opt-in roster guidance and enforce separate GREEN predicates for dispatch, canonical prompt, roster/batch, lane opt-in, and quorum rather than using dispatch as a proxy for the whole M19 cluster.
findings.resolvedReason: AGENTS now independently documents reviewer_list, policy-computed lane opt-in/roster, reviewer_batch, dispatch, agent_prompt, signed run/pass/finding, and quorum prerequisite semantics. M19 omission mutations are rejected.

findings.desc: tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs / CHK-002:happy:0 and CHK-003:edge:0/1 — verified high acceptance blocker: `verification_evidence_add` runs the final verifier to exit 0 but refuses the pinned Unicode/runtime selectors as `receipt_selector_absent` because those proof markers occur after the evidence runner's bounded captured-output window. Repro: re-add CHK-002:happy:0 with selector `UNICODE path=AGENTS.md han=0 ufffd=0 nonAscii=0`; observed exit 1 after the verifier runs. Move the required proof markers into the captured prefix or otherwise bound verifier output without weakening full exit validation, then re-earn all three mechanical receipts.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit e98cbd3b moves unchanged runtime and Unicode checks before verbose ledger output. Owner bulk refresh now records CHK-002:happy:0 and CHK-003:edge:0/1 as mechanical:true with exit 0 and selectorMatched receipts, while full verifier reaches CASE 46 and FINAL GREEN.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:82,88,93 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:484-523 — WHY high acceptance blocker: F-021 was resolved with the claim that all 26 rows now carry exact authoritative path:line citations and the verifier binds each row source, but the citation policy validates only one primary sourcePath/sourcePattern reference per row and never validates any additional cited path, line existence, or substantive relevance. Independent in-memory probe changed the A20 second authority from `packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts:445` to irrelevant existing `package.json:1`; the implemented predicate still reports citationPolicyWouldAccept=true because `packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:692` remains. The fixed removal/vague probes do not cover this bypass. More importantly, the two actual A20 references point only to a DEV memory-preflight line and the scope-contract gate header, while the row claims ProofStory, acceptance topology, delivery/summary, and freshness authority; A09 cites only the required-agent constant while claiming six artifacts/preflight/repair, and A15 cites only `userSees` while claiming excludes/files/intent/related fields. Therefore the durable ledger still lacks exact authority for material parts of its claims, and final GREEN can survive bogus secondary citations. Validate every reference for existence, exact line, and expected source predicate; give each material claimed behavior a supporting exact citation; add a secondary-reference substitution mutation that must fail.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 6d33f19d binds complete ordered authority-reference sets for all 26 rows, validates every exact path and current line through source predicates, requires exact set equality, and rejects missing, vague, stale, duplicate, unexpected, irrelevant, or substituted references. Owner final run exits 0 and explicitly rejects A20 and A09 extra-reference replacement/removal mutations; commit 25837f85 only reorders the same real semantic check for bounded receipt capture.

findings.desc: The CHK-001 edge verification-evidence note and selector still describe CASE 42 as the final case and claim 42 current invocations, but the current verifier ledger reaches CASE 46; CASE 42 is release_approve_push and CASE 43-46 follow. This does not create a false GREEN because the bound tool receipt also requires exitCode=0 and its captured tail contains CASE 46 plus AGENTS_VERIFY FINAL GREEN, so it is non-blocking evidence-prose drift. Reproduce with rg -n CASE .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-d854/checklist.json tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs. Defer by updating the evidence description to avoid a brittle numeric final-case claim in a later metadata maintenance Story.
findings.resolvedReason: Accepted as a nonblocking low-severity metadata-description drift: the executable receipt still exits 0 only after CASE 46 and AGENTS_VERIFY FINAL GREEN. Repro, impact, and remediation are traceably deferred in main draft docs/story/drafts/audit-evidence-case-count-metadata, committed on main as 4839a79be1; this Story does not expand material scope.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:92 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:125-131 — acceptance-blocking incomplete authority-set contract. A19's GREEN resolution materially claims that the signed review_run_start / review_pass_set / finding_add flow is explicit, but AUTHORITY_BY_ROW A19 models only dispatch, agent_prompt, roster, batch, and quorum; it has no authority entry for the three signed-flow commands, whose current registrations are at packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:655, :669, and :2074. A26 similarly claims legacy names are aliases at audit line 99, while its modeled sources only prove body-free/thin prompt rendering; the alias authority is packages/main/src/core/agent-dispatch-registry.ts:36-38 and is not in the A26 set. Consequently auditCitationPolicy can report full exact-set GREEN while these material subclaims remain uncited, and the independent final run did exactly that: exit 0 with 26/26 GREEN and the A09/A20 mutation receipts. WHY high: the user explicitly requires evidence for all 24+2 corrections and the latest F-025 resolution promises complete authority sets, so a verifier-defined incomplete set is a direct acceptance false-green. Add one authority entry per omitted material subclaim, update the audit cells to the exact current lines, and add mutation checks that remove/replace those newly modeled A19/A26 references.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 0534bdb2 adds exact A19 authorities for review_run_start, review_pass_set, pass reviewRunId binding, finding_add and finding reviewRunId binding, plus the exact A26 legacy alias registry authority. The verifier now rejects all 12 A19/A26 replace/remove mutations after refreshed hashes. Owner baseline is 26/26 RED exit 1 and final is 26/26 GREEN/CASE46 exit 0. Proven runtime, Unicode and semantic markers are replayed after all checks so they exist in both the first and last 4KB without weakening final exit.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:92,99 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:125-136,151-155 — F-027 remains acceptance-blocking because the claimed complete authority sets still omit three existing material subclaims. A19 says dispatch is explicit, but its dispatch authority is only packages/main/src/core/agent-dispatch-registry.ts:22, a canonicalName row; it does not prove the registered dispatch command or its target-cardinality validation, which is directly stated at packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:2479 and implemented in packages/main/src/handlers/story-dispatch.ts:884. A19 says reviewer_batch is read-only, but its exact modeled pattern resolves to reviewer-batch.ts:8, which only starts the active-lanes bullet; the read-only contract is at reviewer-batch.ts:2 and the no-side-effect boundary at :32. A26 says host orchestration replaces the legacy model, but its three authorities prove body-free prompt rendering, thin registry mode, and legacy aliases only; host orchestration is explicitly documented at reviewer-batch.ts:21-26 or transition-effects.ts:267. The 12 new A19/A26 remove/replace mutations all pass, but none targets these omitted existing subclaims, so the verifier still reports complete-set GREEN without proving the full row conclusions. WHY high: exact evidence for every one of the 24+2 corrections is the Story's direct acceptance result. Add separate exact authority entries/cell citations for dispatch command validation, reviewer_batch read-only boundary, and host orchestration, then add removal/replacement mutations for each.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 4df805fc completes A19 dispatch command/cardinality/runtime authority, strict read-only reviewer_batch authority, and A26 host-orchestration authority. A19 now has 18 exact entries and the verifier exhaustively rejects removal and irrelevant replacement for every entry (36 mutations); A26 has 4 entries and 8 mutations.

findings.desc: tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:763-770 replays runtime/Unicode/semantic proof only at raw stdout positions 13950-14048, but packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts:200-202 retains only the first 12000 chars and packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:469-472 persists the last 4000 chars of that truncated output. Repro (fresh full verifier): final exit=0 bytes=14125, 26 GREEN, 46 cases; each replay marker has inTrimmed=true only via its early copy but inReceiptTail=false. CLI checklist_get returns the handler object through direct JSON.stringify (cli-engine.ts:1537), so this is not display truncation. Four current mechanical receipts consequently have selectorMatched=true and a tool-owned digest but their underlying outputTail cannot show the pinned Unicode, semantic, or runtime selector. Because this Story promises inspectable evidence and explicitly requires the selector inside the bounded receipt, replay the already-proven markers before byte 12000 but after byte 8000 (or otherwise make the persisted excerpt include them), then refresh evidence. The receipt guard itself remains fail-closed; the defect is human-auditable acceptance evidence, not receipt fabrication.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 4df805fc reorders proven marker replay into the executor-retained window. Owner simulation of validation-executor first-12000 capture and last-4000 receipt tail shows all six unique pinned selectors present at tail offsets 1285-2351; final still exits 0 only after all later checks. Evidence refresh 48d08c6 re-earned 10/10 against current material.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:92 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:125-136 — WHY high acceptance blocker, distinct from F-028: A19 materially claims a signed reviewer run/pass/finding flow, but its new pass/finding authority entries stop at command registration and schema fields. `review_pass_set` has a required reviewRunId field at packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:672, yet the actual signed current-run validation is performed by packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts:360. More critically, `finding_add` declares reviewRunId optional at command-catalog.ts:2089 because main findings may omit it; the reviewer-only requirement is enforced by packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts:519-525. AUTHORITY_BY_ROW never reads either handler predicate, so removing reviewer current-run enforcement would still leave A19 authority policy, all 12 new citation mutations, and final GREEN unchanged. A command field existing is not evidence that the signed reviewer binding is enforced. Add exact handler authorities for pass and reviewer finding current-run validation, bind them in the audit cell, and add removal/replacement mutations for both runtime-enforcement references.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 4df805fc binds A19 signed pass/finding claims to actual runtime assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence enforcement in handlers/finding.ts in addition to command schemas. Exhaustive A19 authority mutations cover every runtime and schema entry; all 36 are rejected and final exits 0.

findings.desc: docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:75-84,97 and tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:86-106,157 — acceptance-blocking global claim-to-authority partition is still incomplete outside A19/A26, despite the code comment promising one authority entry for every material subclaim. Confirmed examples: A04 concludes all registered repository-local aux commands are current, but its only authority is aux_doc_list at command-catalog.ts:1327; the other current commands are separately registered in packages/utils/src/tool-defs.ts:11-28. A08 concludes both INIT-to-INIT_CHECK worktree creation and PLAN cwd enforcement, but maps only lifecycle-registry.ts:145; the independent cwd-worktree gate is at lifecycle-registry.ts:154. A10 resolves owner lease, takeover UX, and session_brief owner rendering, but maps only cli-engine.ts:531 forceTakeover; lease/takeover mechanics are in core/story-owner-lease.ts:411-426 and owner rendering is in handlers/session.ts:520-563. A24 concludes both options=[] rationale and one-option exclusion, but maps only decision.ts:53; the separate single-option branch is decision.ts:63-70. A02 likewise adds CLI-only mutation and bounded-review-read rules beyond the sole storyDir citation. The final verifier still exits 0 because exhaustive citation mutation applies only to A19/A26 (plus focused A09/A20 probes), so it cannot detect these unmapped row clauses. WHY high: the Story promises a claim-by-claim evidence ledger for all M01-M24/L01-L02, not just exhaustive A19/A26 evidence. Partition each row's correction into explicit machine-readable subclaims, add exact authorities for every clause, and exhaustively remove/replace every authority across all 26 rows so a manually incomplete authority declaration cannot define itself as complete.
findings.resolvedReason: Commits fbc8caa4 and 0581e1b7 replace the self-defined partial authority set with an explicit all-row claim partition: 26 rows, 98 globally labeled ordered authority tuples, 62 runtime entries, human-readable kind:label-to-path:line cells, exact parser equality, runtime comment-line rejection, and exhaustive removal plus irrelevant-replacement mutations for every entry (196 total). Known A02/A04/A08/A10/A24 gaps and all other composite rows were audited.

findings.desc: tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:125-159,691-706 and docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:92,99 — WHY high acceptance false-green: the 36+8 exhaustive mutations are real but exhaustive only over a still incomplete and partly circular self-defined authority set. A19 claims strict read-only reviewer_batch runtime behavior, yet the modeled entries resolve to reviewer-batch.ts:2, :8, and :32, all comments; the executable fail-closed boundary and its invocation are reviewer-batch.ts:149-168 and :263. A19 claims quorum_submit requires every current reviewer pass, yet it cites only command-catalog.ts:3080 description; the executable required-lane check and invoked guard are quorum-submit.ts:144-159 and :444. A26 claims host-orchestrator launch instruction, yet it cites reviewer-batch.ts:21 comment; actual generation/use is reviewer-batch.ts:178-181 and :331-333. Removing or bypassing any of these runtime guards/generators leaves every modeled pattern, exact-set policy, and all 36+8 citation mutations GREEN. This also makes the F-028 resolution prose overclaim strict read-only and host-orchestration authority. Add executable handler guard/call-site authorities for these subclaims and adversarial source mutations that remove or bypass each real runtime path, then refresh the audit exact sets and receipts.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit fbc8caa4 binds runtime claims to executable reviewer_batch guards/calls, quorum pass checks/calls, host instruction generation/use, and finding current-run enforcement rather than comments or command descriptions. Runtime-kind source matching rejects comment-only lines. Commit 0581e1b7 exhaustively mutates all 98 entries. Commit bc88d3e4 additionally separates current live runtime drift from verified initial-audit drift without misleading the immutable evidence selector.

findings.desc: tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:249-260,113-120,148-155 and docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:96,105 — WHY high acceptance false-green: runtime authority enforcement only rejects source lines whose trimmed text begins like a comment; it does not prove that a runtime-labeled line is the effective rejecting guard or a consumed call site. Concrete A05 counterexample: runtime:background-trigger-identifier-guard resolves to background-validator.ts:157, which only computes const matched. The actual rejecting guard is :158-164. Deleting or inverting if (!matched) leaves the declared pattern, all 98 tuples, all 196 citation mutations, authority-policy, and final GREEN intact. Concrete A14 counterexample: runtime:plan-to-dev-scope-contract-advisory resolves only to the function declaration at phase-gates.ts:546; the lifecycle call is transition-orchestrator.ts:1152 and is not modeled, so removing the call also leaves final GREEN. A10 has the same definition-without-use weakness for session rendering: session.ts:534 is modeled but its effective use at :1162 is not. Therefore the F-031/F-032 resolution prose overclaims global executable enforcement. Bind guard predicates and lifecycle/render call sites for runtime behavior claims, and add adversarial source-semantic mutations that remove or invert the real guard/call rather than only mutating audit tuples.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 8beb88a binds authority claims to semantic roles and executable producer, guard, consumer, or branch sites. The source-authority suite rejects deletion or inversion of A05, A10, A12, A13, and A14 execution sites and rejects the A05 definition-only downgrade. Owner reran authority, source-authority, baseline, and full final verifiers successfully.

findings.desc: tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:22-30,664-720 and docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:25-41 — WHY high acceptance evidence gap: the historical runtime proof is circular rather than mechanically bound to its claimed tool-owned receipt. INITIAL_RUNTIME_AUDIT hardcodes the old paths, versions, and digest; runtimeChecks only asserts that the audit prose contains those same constants and derives a marker from them. It never reads an immutable prior checklist git object or validates a historical receipt object. Changing the constants and matching audit prose to invented values would satisfy both runtime context mutations and final GREEN. Current checklist receipts have outputDigest 103eac123147..., while 8d66e8e... now appears in their outputTail only because this verifier prints its own hardcoded value; git show 48d08c6:.proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-d854/checklist.json does contain old receipts with outputDigest 8d66e8e..., but that immutable object/path is not referenced or consumed, and the retained old tail does not independently bind every claimed path/version. The current-vs-historical labels are separated, but the historical facts are not proven. Bind an exact immutable evidence object and mechanically parse/validate the receipt and the facts it actually retained, or narrow the audit prose to facts the durable receipt can demonstrate; add a mutation of the historical values/digest that fails without relying on duplicated constants.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 8beb88a removes the circular historical constants proof. The verifier parses immutable Git commit 48d08c69e90dd9d90c7b783a112e54aa955d6241 and blob 94a3682f2349e0fb42cbfb4ddea784c04a715201, selects CHK-003:edge:1 receipt digest 8d66e8eae81c7be7326397a8c80b60a123bf1fabf1abfedb75d3cac2a5927748, and verifies its unique preserved classification selector. The audit explicitly narrows the historical claim to classification-only; current exact runtime facts remain live-computed.

findings.desc: Durable audit overclaims a global semantic-role completeness guarantee that the verifier does not enforce. docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:91-94 says composite behavioral claims require complete producer-to-consumer or guard/branch chains and definition-only citations cannot satisfy those rows. In tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs, authority() defaults every unannotated entry to role=support (:99), REQUIRED_AUTHORITY_ROLES contains only A05/A10/A12/A13/A14 (:265-271), and validateAuthorityRoleCompleteness iterates only that map (:273-281). Consequently composite rows A18, A19, A20, A21, A22, A24, A25, and A26 have no enforced semantic role chain; changing all their entry roles to definition/support does not enter the completeness check. The sole definition-only mutation targets A05 (:349-360), and executable source mutations cover only five rows (:326-346). Current source citations may resolve, but the claimed false-green defense is not established for the broader composite set. Fix by either narrowing the audit claim explicitly to the five protected rows, or assign and enforce required semantic roles for every composite behavioral row and add representative definition-only/source mutations across that set.

It binds 86 role entries and individually deletes or inverts 66 executable endpoints; all 66 mutations are rejected. Audit wording now matches this exact guarantee.

findings.desc: F-037 remains false-green. docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:100-106 promises that each material subclaim has its own named chain, unrelated subclaims cannot be pooled, and broken chains are rejected. tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:358-379 checks only endpoint label membership, declared role equality, per-row uniqueness/set equality, and non-definition runtime presence; it never validates that a producer/guard pair belongs to the same behavior. Repro without modifying repository files: load tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs in memory, swap A20's `review-entry-verification-evidence-guard` and `done-open-bug-guard` between the `review-evidence-gate` and `done-bug-gate` chains, then run the transformed module with --source-authority-policy. Observed exit=0 and `SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY PASS rows=26 semanticChainRows=13 chains=40 semanticRoleEntries=86 sourceMutations=66 roleMutations=1`. All 66 source mutations still pass because they prove endpoint presence, not pair linkage. The modeled-row set also omits A09 despite its composite interface/runtime claims: init_preflight registration plus boundary call and two repair rejection guards (authority entries at tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:157-163; no A09 chain at :299-356). Fix with an independent immutable expected chain-to-endpoint mapping or relationship assertions/mutations that reject cross-chain same-role swaps, and justify or model every composite row such as A09; counts derived solely from REQUIRED_AUTHORITY_CHAINS cannot prove completeness.

findings.desc: tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:1004-1008 — acceptance blocker: runtimeChecks assumes the globally resolved /opt/homebrew/bin/proof-or-stop entrypoint is directly executable and hard-asserts spawn status 0. On the current host its target is mode 0644 and version 0.3.271; direct execution returns EACCES, spawnSync.status is null, and both `node tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs --runtime-policy` and `--receipt-window-policy` fail at line 1007. CHK-003:edge:1 requires global version/path drift to be reported as a distinct environment finding without substituting it for repository-local authority or treating unrelated host drift as AGENTS inconsistency. The current hard assertion instead prevents the final proof and the new receipt-window claim from being rerun. Handle unavailable/non-executable global runtime as an explicit environment classification while keeping the local 0.3.270 worktree CLI authoritative, or restore a mechanically verified executable global entrypoint before resubmission.
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of F-041, as explicitly confirmed by the concept reviewer. The single global-entrypoint executability/runtime-policy root cause is fixed and evidenced under F-041.

findings.desc: Runtime fallback contract still accepts a contradictory success-plus-fallback state. docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md:42-46 promises that the resolved-artifact Node fallback is used only when direct global execution is unavailable. In tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs:1007-1012, the directStatus===0 branch validates versionSource=DIRECT but never requires fallbackStatus===null; renderRuntimeEvidence at :1025 faithfully renders fallbackOutcome=EXIT_0 if that contradictory field is present, and runtimeReportPolicy accepts its own rendering. Verified no-file-write repro: load the verifier in memory, call inspectRuntimeEnvironment, set global directStatus=0, directErrorCode=null, directOutcome=EXIT_0, versionSource=DIRECT, fallbackStatus=0, recompute classification, then call validateRuntimeEvidence(...,{bindObservedPaths:false}) and runtimeReportPolicy(...). Observed exit=0 and `SUCCESS_PLUS_FALLBACK FALSE_GREEN`. Existing runtimeEvidenceMutationChecks (:1037-1047) do not mutate fallbackStatus, while both executable simulations manually set it null rather than testing rejection. Add mutually exclusive invariants: direct success must require errorCode=null and fallbackStatus=null; any fallback must require directStatus!==0 plus fallbackStatus=0, and add both success-plus-fallback and inconsistent status/error mutations. The live EXIT_0 report and 18/18 receipt window currently pass, but do not prove this promised fallback-only boundary.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 6ac3238 enforces mutually exclusive DIRECT and NODE_FALLBACK evidence states and a sole selected version source. It rejects direct-and-fallback double success and inconsistent fallback state. Owner verified runtime policy, baseline 26/26 RED, receipt-window 18/18, and refreshed all 10 evidence records.
